product.name: Noble Monk Men's Polyester Regular Fit Solid Casual Polo Shirt
product.description: A men's regular-fit solid polo shirt made from polyester, featuring half sleeves, a polo collar and standard length. Designed primarily for casual and summer wear.

review_summary.summary: Customers frequently praise the shirt's soft, lightweight and comfortable feel, casual appearance, colors and value for money. However, quality consistency is a significant concern. Some verified buyers report fabric shagging after one wash, poor stitching, low-quality material, dull appearance and products not matching the displayed image.

buying_advice.size_advice: The listing provides S through 2XL. Reviews generally describe the fit as regular or good, but at least one reviewer found L too large. Check the size chart before ordering.
buying_advice.fabric_advice: The listing explicitly identifies the material as polyester. Do not market it as cotton or linen.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Do not call this premium or highly durable. The review record contains both strong positive quality feedback and serious complaints about fabric and stitching.
buying_advice.value_assessment: At the captured ₹270 price against an MRP of ₹1,299, affordability is the product's strongest commercial advantage.
buying_advice.office_wear_advice: Do not prioritize this for formal office recommendations. One reviewer specifically said it was suitable for casual regular use but not office or professional wear.

source_inconsistencies: Customer experiences vary significantly on fabric and stitching quality.

shopi_ai_rules.primary_rule: Recommend this primarily as a budget casual polo shirt, especially for summer and everyday use.
shopi_ai_rules.material_rule: State the material as polyester. Do not describe it as cotton, linen or premium natural fabric.
shopi_ai_rules.quality_rule: Do not claim premium or highly durable construction because customer feedback is inconsistent.
shopi_ai_rules.fit_rule: Use Regular Fit as the catalog attribute but encourage users to check the size chart.
shopi_ai_rules.price_rule: Use affordability and value for money as major selling points.
shopi_ai_rules.stitching_rule: Do not promise strong or durable stitching.
shopi_ai_rules.summer_rule: Summer recommendations are reasonable because the listing specifies Summer and multiple customers describe the fabric as lightweight, soft and breathable.
shopi_ai_rules.office_rule: Avoid recommending this as formal office wear. Position it as casual or relaxed wear.
shopi_ai_rules.description_rule: Do not guarantee that the physical product will perfectly match the listing images because reviews disagree on image accuracy.
shopi_ai_rules.comparison_rule: When comparing with SHIRT-006, prefer SHIRT-007 for a polo-style, half-sleeve, budget casual/summer use case. Do not prefer it for long-sleeve button-down or business-casual needs.
